translations.web: Oh give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
translations.bsb: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
translations.kjv: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever.
